metadata.database: A Deeper China | Suzhou decision layer

SZUM01.guest_need: A visitor wants gardens as designed space, not a list of famous names.
SZUM01.hidden_need: Choose one garden question and control crowd/transfer fatigue.
SZUM01.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: One garden read closely reveals spatial composition better than collecting several entrances.
SZUM01.stop_condition: The visitor can explain one relationship between borrowed view, movement and enclosure.
SZUM01.low_energy_branch: Choose one accessible garden and a seated pause.
SZUM01.body_cost: Moderate walking, queues, weather and attention load.

SZUM02.guest_need: A visitor wants Suzhou as a working water-city and urban history, not just a garden.
SZUM02.hidden_need: Connect canals, craft, trade and current public life in one coherent route.
SZUM02.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: One water-city sequence adds the city’s working layer that a second garden cannot.
SZUM02.stop_condition: The guest can connect water, commerce, streets and current use.
SZUM02.low_energy_branch: Use one canal/public-street section and an indoor history stop.
SZUM02.rain_branch: Keep covered water-city/history layers only after access check.
SZUM02.body_cost: Moderate walking with crossings, crowds and weather exposure.

SZUM03.guest_need: A visitor wants craft or performance as living cultural production.
SZUM03.hidden_need: Match the current programme rather than promise a workshop or show.
SZUM03.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: One current craft/music question is deeper than adding another historic façade.
SZUM03.stop_condition: One material, sound or performance structure is understood.
SZUM03.rain_branch: Strong indoor branch after programme/ticket checks.

SZUM04.guest_need: A visitor wants architecture beyond the garden postcard.
SZUM04.hidden_need: Use one adaptive-reuse or residential/public-space question.
SZUM04.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: One architectural contrast explains how Suzhou changes beyond classical gardens.
SZUM04.stop_condition: One building/street relationship is legible without a façade hunt.
SZUM04.body_cost: Low-to-moderate walking with weather and privacy boundaries.

SZUM05.guest_need: A visitor needs to decide if a water town deserves a separate day.
SZUM05.hidden_need: Prevent a picturesque transfer from replacing Suzhou city depth.
SZUM05.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: A water-town day adds a different settlement question only when extra time exists.
SZUM05.stop_condition: The visitor accepts transfer, crowds and a distinct water-town purpose.
SZUM05.low_energy_branch: Keep Suzhou city and omit the water town.
SZUM05.rain_branch: Use current transport and indoor options before adding it.

SZUM06.guest_need: A repeat visitor wants contemporary Suzhou, design or public systems.
SZUM06.hidden_need: Match current programme to a real question instead of adding another old street.
SZUM06.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: One current-city layer adds a new question beyond gardens and canals.

SZUM07.guest_need: A visitor needs to decide whether Suzhou is a Shanghai day trip or an overnight.
SZUM07.hidden_need: Protect garden, rail and last-mile buffers.
SZUM07.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: A pacing decision prevents a garden-and-rail sprint from replacing the intended experience.
SZUM07.stop_condition: The visitor has one anchor, train buffer and overnight decision.
SZUM07.low_energy_branch: Choose one garden or stay overnight.
SZUM07.rain_branch: Use current rail and indoor programme before changing the plan.
SZUM07.body_cost: Rail, last-mile and crowd timing are primary costs.

SZUM08.guest_need: A visitor needs Suzhou to survive heat, rain, stairs and family/mobility constraints.
SZUM08.hidden_need: Make recovery and rail buffers part of the route.
SZUM08.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: A recovery/mobility layer prevents a beautiful but unusable garden plan.
SZUM08.stop_condition: The visitor has a credible route with rest and weather fallback.
SZUM08.low_energy_branch: Keep one accessible anchor and a protected buffer.
SZUM08.body_cost: Operational cost: heat, stairs, crowds, shade and last-mile transfers.
